description: This file defines the 'SliceFixture' class used for integration testing within the Conduit project. It manages in-memory database setup, dependency injection, and provides utility methods for executing scoped actions and sending requests via MediatR during tests.

classes.name: SliceFixture
classes.description: A helper class for setting up and managing a test environment with in-memory database and dependency injection for integration tests.

methods.name: SliceFixture
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the test services, configures in-memory database, and prepares the IServiceProvider.

methods.name: GetDbContext
methods.description: Returns the ConduitContext instance from the service provider.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Deletes the temporary in-memory database file upon disposal.

methods.name: ExecuteScopeAsync
methods.description: Executes an asynchronous action within a new dependency injection scope.

methods.name: ExecuteScopeAsync<T>
methods.description: Executes an asynchronous function within a scope and returns its result.

methods.name: SendAsync
methods.description: Sends a request through MediatR within a scoped environment and returns the response.

methods.name: SendAsync (overload)
methods.description: Sends a request without expecting a response, within a parameterized scope.

methods.name: ExecuteDbContextAsync (without return)
methods.description: Executes a database operation within a scope.

methods.name: ExecuteDbContextAsync<T>
methods.description: Executes a database operation that returns a result within a scope.

methods.name: InsertAsync
methods.description: Inserts entities into the database within a scope, then saves changes.
